# Dr. Muhammet Dilber · Istanbul Rhinoplasty Center

> Assoc. Prof. Dr. Muhammet Dilber is an ear, nose and throat (ENT) surgeon in Istanbul, Türkiye, whose practice is focused on rhinoplasty: primary, revision and functional (breathing) nose surgery. He leads the Istanbul Rhinoplasty Center in Bakırköy, Istanbul, and offers a free photo assessment for U.S. patients.

## Key facts
- Name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Muhammet Dilber (Turkish: Doç. Dr. Muhammet Dilber)
- Specialty: Otorhinolaryngology (ENT), rhinoplasty and nasal surgery
- Training: MD and ENT residency, Bursa Uludağ University; Associate Professor of Otorhinolaryngology (2024)
- Experience: 25 years in practice, more than 10,000 operations
- Hospitals: JCI-accredited private hospital in Istanbul; admission privileges at Acıbadem Bakırköy Hospital; previously Safa Hospital and the American Hospital, Istanbul
- Memberships: European Facial Plastic Surgery Association; Turkish ENT Head and Neck Surgery Association; Turkish Medical Association
- Procedures: primary rhinoplasty, revision rhinoplasty (including second and third revisions), septorhinoplasty, ultrasonic (piezo) rhinoplasty, septum, turbinate and nasal valve correction
- Cost: primary rhinoplasty from $9,000 (USD); revision quoted individually after a photo review
- Typical stay in Istanbul: 7–10 days
- Reviews: 4.9 out of 5 from 397 reviews on RealSelf (checked August 2026)
- Clinic address: Ataköy 2-5-6. Mah. Rauf Orbay Cad. 4 Yalı Ataköy Apart Ofis C Blok, D: 29, Bakırköy, Istanbul, Türkiye
- Contact for U.S. patients: WhatsApp +1 415 767 8263
